i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load epic #453, ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, LESSONS.md Active. Record pass when loaded.

q1-intent.title: Epic intent & success shape (incl. honest-null acceptability)
q1-intent.imperative: Self-resolve from epic #453 body: intent, wave structure, done-bar, honest-null acceptability. Confirm with human.
q1-intent.finding: Intent: evo maintenance track in the physics-primary era; ONLY non-physics-limited work (lap-time-derived features, model-side investigation, process). 3 ordered waves: W1 #410/#413/#451 (bounded, parallel-safe), W2 #425/#394/#395 (feature/encoding, informed by W1, accumulate without individual regens), W3 #440 (gold refresh + walk-forward backtest capstone — the single measured checkpoint). Done-bar: W1-2 dispositioned then #440 executed with promoted bundle + walk-forward fantasy score vs prior baseline. Honest-null IS a complete deliverable (epic explicitly allows measured-no for #451 and W2 items).

q2-checkpoint.title: Checkpoint protocol / autonomy cadence
q2-checkpoint.imperative: ASK human: stop-and-present at each wave boundary, or cleared autonomous through some checkpoint?
q2-checkpoint.finding: Cleared autonomous through all waves; no stop-and-confirm at wave boundaries IF admiral is convinced requests are met. File a descriptive report between each wave (user AFK). HARD STOP before merging/promoting the gold bundle (#440).

q3-decision-classes.title: Decision classes delegated vs surfaced (esp. merge-to-main authority)
q3-decision-classes.imperative: ASK human: which decision classes may the Admiral adjudicate vs surface? Merge-to-main is 'ask first' by default in ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT — delegate within this epic gated on green checks, or approve each?
q3-decision-classes.finding: Merge-to-main DELEGATED after each wave gated on quality (green checks + diff review). Gold-bundle promotion SURFACED (explicit stop). Subagent use encouraged. Scope/architecture changes surfaced per default.

q4-budget-model.title: Budget / model tier / compute
q4-budget-model.imperative: ASK human: commander model tier (Sonnet default per memory; Opus for hard issues?); #440 gold refresh is heavy compute (NN training, 10-15 min). Session-window awareness.
q4-budget-model.finding: Commanders: Sonnet default; Opus for #451 and #440. Crews: Sonnet (commanders must be told). No explicit budget ceiling given.

q5-prerulings-expiry.title: Pre-rulings & contract expiry
q5-prerulings-expiry.imperative: Propose pre-rulings (DB-only, Brier-primary, honest-null OK, no leakage) and an expiry (event-based: end of wave 2, or time). Human confirms/overrides.
q5-prerulings-expiry.finding: Pre-rulings accepted as proposed: DB-only analysis, Brier-primary vs calibrated baseline, honest-null complete, no leakage (walk-forward/as-of), runbook-first for #440, regenerate-not-hand-edit. Expiry: event-based at the #440 gold-promotion stop (replaces wave-2/3 re-confirm since user cleared through).

q6-comms.title: Comms style
q6-comms.imperative: Self-resolve from memory (plain English, depth on demand). Confirm.
q6-comms.finding: Plain English by default, technical depth on demand (user memory user-plain-english + plain-text-decision-questions: in remote-control, rationale-heavy decisions asked in plain text not AskUserQuestion).

consolidation.summary: Latitude resolved: autonomous through waves 1-3 with between-wave written reports; merges delegated gated on quality; hard stop before gold-bundle promotion; Sonnet commanders (Opus for 451/440), Sonnet crews; standard pre-rulings; expiry at the gold-promotion stop.
